name: Blue-haired Head (source cuts)

motion.body: The complete assembled source is animated by the existing damped spring, squash/stretch, drag inertia and edge response.
motion.hair: Source cutouts use low-amplitude velocity lag.
motion.eyes: Independent source cutouts stay on their original anchors because the image has no replacement eye poses and no pixels behind the eyes.

provenance: Every visible source-layer pixel is extracted from source-reference.png. No face, eye or accessory pixels are generated or repainted.
